title: Reported federal lobbying spending
cap: Total reported federal lobbying spending, billions of nominal dollars (not inflation-adjusted), from Lobbying Disclosure Act filings compiled by OpenSecrets; 2008–2021 as published by 24/7 Wall St. (July 2022), 2023–2024 via Statista (May 2025); 2022 not available in these sources. OpenSecrets put 2025 at about $5bn.
